title.zh-TW: 10月外銷訂單1,238億美元、年增78.3%，連21紅並雙創新高
title.en: Taiwan's October export orders hit record US$123.8bn, up 78.3% for 21st straight gain

summary.zh-TW: 經濟日報報導，經濟部20日公布10月外銷訂單1,238.2億美元，年增78.3%，金額與增幅皆創新高、連21個月正成長；資通訊產品年增107.2%、電子產品年增89.8%，主因AI與雲端資本支出。經濟部預估11月接單1,150至1,187億美元、全年可望突破1.1兆美元，惟11月資通訊接單動向指數為47.8。
summary.en: Economic Daily News reports the economy ministry said Oct. export orders reached US$123.82bn, up 78.3% y/y, both records and a 21st monthly gain. ICT orders rose 107.2% and electronics 89.8%, driven by AI and cloud capex. The ministry forecasts Nov. orders of US$115.0-118.7bn and full-year orders above US$1.1tn, though its Nov. ICT order index stands at 47.8.

impact.zh-TW: 官方數據顯示AI相關接單至10月仍強，與近期股價重挫形成落差；但11月預估增幅放緩，且接單不等於出貨與獲利，市場可能更關注後續月份動能是否延續。
impact.en: Official data show AI-linked orders stayed strong through October, in contrast with the recent share slump. But the ministry expects slower November growth, and orders are not shipments or profits; markets may focus on whether momentum holds.

title.zh-TW: Anthropic上市未能止跌，那斯達克抹去今年漲幅
title.en: Anthropic IPO fails to halt AI sell-off as Nasdaq erases year's gains

summary.zh-TW: Yahoo Finance報導，Anthropic本週上市未能緩解AI類股賣壓，那斯達克已抹去今年以來漲幅、距10月高點約18%；輝達四週跌42%，美光一個月跌逾33%。報導列出的原因包括資料中心監管趨嚴、對中晶片出口限制與融資疑慮；10年期美債殖利率週五降至4.91%。分析師對是否「錯殺」看法分歧。
summary.en: Yahoo Finance reports Anthropic's IPO this week did little to stem AI-stock selling: the Nasdaq erased its year-to-date gain and sits about 18% below its October high, Nvidia is down 42% in four weeks and Micron over 33% in a month. Cited causes include tighter data-center rules, China chip-export curbs and financing worries. Strategists are split on whether it is a 'fire sale'.

impact.zh-TW: 美股AI類股的評價修正可能延續影響台灣AI供應鏈情緒；部分策略師認為是基本面良好公司遭拋售、也有人示警結構性因素，屬觀點而非已確認走勢。
impact.en: The US AI valuation reset may keep weighing on sentiment toward Taiwan's AI supply chain. Some strategists call it a sale of quality names while others warn of structural forces; these are views, not confirmed trends.

title.zh-TW: CNN：至少6所美國黑名單中國大學採購受管制輝達晶片
title.en: CNN: at least six US-blacklisted Chinese universities bought controlled Nvidia chips

summary.zh-TW: 中央社綜合外電、聯合新聞網刊載，CNN檢視約300筆商業紀錄，發現至少6所遭美列入黑名單的中國大學申報採購受出口管制的輝達晶片，其中2所與軍方關係密切者於近幾個月購入，多經不知名中國賣家、以較舊及小量晶片為主。CNN無法確認是否實際交貨，紀錄也可能不完整；白宮正推動堵漏。
summary.en: Per CNA via UDN, CNN reviewed about 300 commercial records and found at least six US-blacklisted Chinese universities reported buying export-controlled Nvidia chips, two with close military ties in recent months, mostly older chips in small volumes via obscure sellers. CNN could not verify delivery and the records may be incomplete; the White House is moving to close loopholes.

impact.zh-TW: 晶片流向疑慮可能強化美方執法與管制力道，增加AI晶片供應鏈的合規成本與政策不確定性；目前屬媒體調查，未見官方對個案的結論。
impact.en: Diversion concerns may strengthen US enforcement and controls, raising compliance costs and policy uncertainty for the AI chip supply chain. This is a media investigation; no official finding on these cases is reported.

title.zh-TW: Fed理事庫克：未來可能需要更多且更大幅度升息
title.en: Fed's Cook says more and larger rate hikes may be needed

summary.zh-TW: Yahoo Finance轉載24/7 Wall St.報導，Fed理事庫克20日在智利央行年會表示，9月單次升息不太可能改變通膨路徑，若延誤「之後可能需要更多且更大幅度升息」追趕。她是10月主張再升息的兩位異議者之一。報導稱期貨約反映92%機率在12月8至9日會議升息1碼；同日標普500跌3.70%、10年期殖利率降至4.92%。
summary.en: Yahoo Finance, carrying 24/7 Wall St., reports Fed Governor Lisa Cook said on Nov. 20 in Chile that one September hike is unlikely to alter the inflation path and that 'additional and larger' hikes may be needed later if policy lags. She was one of two October dissenters favoring a hike. Futures price about 92% odds of a quarter-point hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting; the S&P 500 fell 3.70% that day.

impact.zh-TW: Fed官員偏鷹言論使12月升息預期升溫，高利率可能壓抑高評價科技股並影響資金成本；殖利率同步下滑也反映市場擔憂景氣放緩，升息幅度仍待會議決定。
impact.en: Hawkish Fed remarks raise December hike expectations; higher rates may weigh on richly valued tech and funding costs. Falling yields also suggest growth worries. The size of any hike awaits the meeting.

title.zh-TW: 美國家情報總監：輝達晶片是非法取得目標，相關調查進行中
title.en: US intelligence chief says Nvidia chips are a target of illicit acquisition; probes ongoing

summary.zh-TW: 中央社綜合外電報導，美國國家情報總監克雷頓22日受訪表示，輝達高階晶片一直是有人企圖非法取得的目標，其他公司已有相關起訴案例；他證實司法部正調查新加坡業者Megaspeed前高層及該公司，但未進一步評論。報導引述彭博稱涉案人疑為中國間諜，屬未證實指控；前執行長黃仁勳否認不當行為，預定12月1日出席眾院閉門會議。
summary.en: CNA says US intelligence chief Jay Clayton said Nov. 22 that Nvidia's high-end chips are a target of illegal acquisition and confirmed a Justice Department probe of a former Megaspeed executive and the Singapore firm without details. Spy claims cited from Bloomberg are unverified; ex-CEO Jensen Huang denies wrongdoing and is due at a closed House session Dec. 1.

impact.zh-TW: 調查與國會聽證可能延長輝達治理及對中關係的不確定性，並使晶片出口管制執法更受關注；調查結果與政策影響尚未明朗，不宜視為已確認的業務衝擊。
impact.en: The probe and hearing may prolong uncertainty over Nvidia's governance and China ties and sharpen focus on export-control enforcement. Outcomes and policy effects are unclear and should not be read as confirmed business damage.

reason.zh-TW: 全球AI晶片主要代工廠；10月電子產品外銷接單強勁，但輝達相關調查與對中晶片管制執法升溫，可能影響AI供應鏈情緒。屬產業推論。
reason.en: Major foundry for AI chips. October electronics orders were strong, but Nvidia-related probes and tighter China chip enforcement may weigh on AI supply-chain sentiment. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 美股AI評價修正延續、出口管制擴大與客戶需求變化。
risk.en: Extended US AI valuation reset, wider export controls and shifts in customer demand.

reason.zh-TW: AI伺服器組裝要角；資通訊產品10月接單年增逾倍，但輝達治理與對中關係不確定性可能牽動AI伺服器供應鏈評價。屬產業推論。
reason.en: Key AI server assembler. ICT orders more than doubled y/y in October, but uncertainty over Nvidia's governance and China ties may affect AI server supply-chain valuations. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: AI伺服器需求或拉貨節奏放緩、匯率與毛利壓力。
risk.en: Slower AI server demand or pull-ins, currency and margin pressure.

reason.zh-TW: 雲端AI伺服器代工廠；外銷接單反映雲端資本支出仍強，但美股AI類股重挫顯示市場對AI投資回報與融資疑慮升高。屬產業推論。
reason.en: Cloud AI server maker. Export orders show cloud capex still strong, but the US AI sell-off reflects rising doubts about AI returns and financing. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 雲端業者資本支出下修、評價修正與資料中心監管趨嚴。
risk.en: Cloud capex cuts, valuation reset and tighter data-center regulation.

reason.zh-TW: DRAM廠；報導指美光一個月跌逾33%，記憶體類股情緒受AI賣壓衝擊，升息預期也可能影響景氣循環股評價。屬產業推論。
reason.en: DRAM maker. Micron fell over 33% in a month amid the AI sell-off, hurting memory sentiment, and hike expectations may weigh on cyclical valuations. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 記憶體價格循環反轉、AI需求預期下修與利率上升。
risk.en: Memory price-cycle reversal, lower AI demand expectations and rising rates.

reason.zh-TW: 大型壽險金控；Fed可能續升息將影響債券評價與避險成本，股市劇烈波動也牽動投資收益。屬產業推論。
reason.en: Large life-insurance-led group. Further Fed hikes may affect bond valuations and hedging costs, and sharp equity swings may hit investment income. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 利率與匯率大幅波動、股市續跌造成評價損失。
risk.en: Large rate and currency swings and further equity losses.
